name: Spacemonkeys's endgame controller rolls
description: Recommendations for controller from Spacemonkey's endgame rolls doc.

Not in love with the perk combos for this crossbow tbh. Withering Gaze is cool, but is it worth the heavy slot? Repulsor + Destab combo from the heavy slot is interesting, but worth it? This is now the best sidearm in the game. The archetype is not the strongest for either sidearms or the dynamic heat family, but the perk combination and the natural strength of the sidearms (highest damage primary weapons) cant be beat. This is a very impressive primary weapon. No other blaster from this season really rewards you as demonstrably as this one does for using the Dynamic Heat Limiter proc in just general play.

This is a really hard weapon to evaluate for both PvE and PvP as it is our only Balanced Heat weapon (at least until the dungeon comes out). Remember that Balanced weapons need to be manually reloaded/vented just before overheating to get the massive reload bonus. If youre good at that little minigame then this is the best Peacekeepers DPS roll in the kinetic slot (you really want Accelerated Assault for that purpose). This is probably just fine in roam content so if you enjoy it go ahead. For PvP this could be quite good or excessively mediocre. It has the rolls for it, just a question of how the frame performs. After doing some testing basically any target lock fast talker with accelerated assault is slightly superior to antedate for peacekeepers dps. With that in mind if you go attrition orbs then youll be consistently getting some good utility while doing a solid rotation. That being said cooling baubles has the potential to go absolutely nuts if you can pick up some orbs or elemental pickups while strafing and shooting: were talking like 2-5x longer single mag than either antedate or a non-baubles fast talker. So the way to look at it is that cooling baubles wont always work, but the gun at base will still be slightly better than an antedate and it has the potential to every once in awhile go nuts on dps. Conversely attrition orbs has a lower ceiling but will more consistently pump out utility. Both good options, just depends on your roll and your personal preference.
PvE Masterworks: Reload, Cooling Efficiency, Range, Handling
PvP Masterworks: Range, Handling, Stability

Grip instead of origin trait hurts in PvE, but this gun is so unique and so cool that its worth it even without one. The main reason that this gun isnt DOA for PvE is because bungie actually custom tuned the damage scalars for red bars and elites to be higher than the rest of the SMG family, so it actually winds up being one of the strongest weapons for the season. The obvious and most direct comparison is to THE Multimach roll - Attrition Orbs & Kinetic Tremors. While Multimach procs both effects faster, Peculiar Charm simply does more damage. In a vacuum Id probably still take Multimach, but with the New Gear bonus active the draw of Peculiar Charm is too strong this season.
PvP is a different story but a similar ending. This is actually pretty good there, having crazy range for an SMG and being pretty forgiving. Fitted Stock seems to be super important, along with as much range stat as possible.
PvE Masterworks: Reload, Range, Handling

This is not Mint Retrograde. No Rewind Rounds and no Bait & Switch means that is pretty much fundamentally not a universally applicable and solitary DPS weapon - at least not until the shiny origin trait - Accelerated Assault - gets fixed on this. The only real situation where that could have been true is one Storms Keep titan since trickle charge will automatically fill the mag behind the barricade, except the only real DPS perk is Elemental Honing which hates being on a true subclass since the options to stack up different elements are so limited. That being said, as a supplemental DPS option in a rotation, especially on a prismatic subclass that can take advantage of multiple elements easily, this can definitely find a home. Overall its a weapon that hits very hard and should be good for general content and even some higher end content where you just want any rocket pulse and this frees up the kinetic slot. Assuming they fix the bug with Accelerated Assault on rocket pulses and fusion rifles then the need for Trickle Charge, or any reload perk, goes down. Which means Blast Distributor actually looks pretty nice.
PvE Masterworks: Handling, Blast Radius, Reload, Velocity

This gun is so cool. Hits like an absolute truck and is supported so nicely by the artifact this season - and all of that in addition to being a perfect pairing for the Praxic Blade which is also Kinetic and allows you to double dip your surges. You really want Accelerated Assault here - as is the case with any DPS focused weapon this season. Perk 1 slot is basically just a big whiff, so its kinda whatever you personally want. I like Bewildering Burst because I like the availability of the extra crowd control if I want it, but in general a perk focused on landing your crits as fast as possible is probably the best option for most people. Overall you want to juice your reload stat as much as possible.

As it stands this gun has BiS rolls for both PvE and PvP and is a major beneficiary of the Accelerated Assault origin trait - which makes this blow Lionfish out of the water. The difference between Vorpal and Controlled Burst is actually pretty small. Vorpal is better if youre shooting between 1-4 shots in one go, Controlled Burst takes over at 5+ shots.
